a.xlink:title: Scope Function: Executes a side effect block and returns the Scope for chaining.
Null-Safe Variant: Executes the side effect block only if the value is non-null.
Scope Function: Executes a configuration block and returns the Scope for chaining.
Null-Safe Variant: Executes the configuration block only if the value is non-null.
Factory Method: Entry point for scope chaining.
